text: tmux: prefix + z zooms a pane. Repeat to return.
tmux: prefix + / searches your scrollback.
tmux: prefix + w finds a window without losing your place.
tmux: prefix + g opens your project picker.
Ctrl+R searches shell history. Your past self left clues.
Neovim: <leader>xx opens diagnostics; fix one cause at a time.
Neovim: <leader>ks searches your vault knowledge.
Neovim: ]d / [d visits the next / previous diagnostic.
